title: 女 woman (女字旁)
intro: 女 means woman. On the left it narrows, and its last horizontal stroke becomes a short rising stroke (妈, 姐). At the bottom it keeps its full shape (要, 妻). Characters with 女 are often family members, marriage, and some very common words whose link to "woman" is historical.

ex.p: wǒ mā ma shì yī shēng
tā shì wǒ jiě jie

ex.zh: 我有两个姐姐，一个妹妹。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè jiě jie yī gè mèi mei
ex.en: I have two older sisters, and one younger sister.

ex.zh: 小姐，请问洗手间在哪儿？
ex.p: xiǎo jie qǐng wèn xǐ shǒu jiān zài nǎr
ex.en: Miss, excuse me, where's the restroom?

ex.p: wǒ mèi mei shí suì

ex.zh: 我有两个姐姐，一个妹妹。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè jiě jie yī gè mèi mei
ex.en: I have two older sisters, and one younger sister.

ex.p: wǒ xū yào yī bēi niú nǎi
ex.en: I need a glass of milk.

ex.p: wǒ nǎi nai jīn nián bā shí suì le
ex.en: My grandma is eighty this year.

ex.p: nǎi nai xǐ huan hē niú nǎi

ex.zh: 她是一个很可爱的姑娘。
ex.p: tā shì yī gè hěn kě ài de gū niang
tā shì wǒ jiě jie
nín guì xìng wǒ xìng wáng
ex.en: What's your surname? My surname is Wang.

ex.p: qǐng xiě nǐ de xìng míng
diàn yǐng yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le

tā men jié hūn sān nián le
tā men xià gè yuè jié hūn
wǒ xū yào yī bēi niú nǎi
ex.en: I need a glass of milk.

ex.p: zhè jiàn shì duì wǒ hěn zhòng yào
ex.en: This matters a lot to me.

ex.p: nǐ yào hē shén me
ex.en: What do you want to drink?

ex.p: tā de qī zǐ shì lǎo shī

ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
ex.p: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù le
ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

ex.zh: 我喜欢水果，比如苹果和香蕉。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan shuǐ guǒ bǐ rú píng guǒ hé xiāng jiāo
ex.en: I like fruit, for example apples and bananas.

texts.title: 读一读 · 女 woman (女字旁)

lines.zh: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、奶奶、姐姐和我。
lines.p: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén bà ba mā ma nǎi nai jiě jie hé wǒ

lines.zh: 我姐姐今年二十八岁，下个月就要结婚了。
lines.p: wǒ jiě jie jīn nián èr shí bā suì xià gè yuè jiù yào jié hūn le

lines.zh: 她的男朋友姓李，是一个医生。
lines.p: tā de nán péng you xìng li shì yī gè yī shēng

lines.zh: 奶奶很高兴，她说：“你们结婚以后，要常常回家看看我。”
lines.p: nǎi nai hěn gāo xìng tā shuō nǐ men jié hūn yǐ hòu yào cháng cháng huí jiā kàn kàn wǒ
